issues.description: The reference solution for Aufgabe 07 (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql) omits the join condition between Gemeinde and Schwimmbad. As written, SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Schwimmbad.art='Freibad' produces a cartesian product and does not correctly associate each Freibad with its Gemeinde. This contradicts the task description which asks for the Gemeinden that have a Freibad and the names of the respective Freibäder, and will confuse students about the required join.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the join condition between Gemeinde and Schwimmbad in the solution. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; This ensures each Freibad is correctly matched to its Gemeinde and aligns the solution with the task description.
